original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original adult character portrait for a cohesive premium 3D romance-game character collection. Not a live-action photograph, not flat anime, not a doll or plastic toy. All characters aged 22-28. Clean opaque pure white #FFFFFF seamless background with no gray gradient, scenery or props behind them. Consistent neutral soft frontal studio key plus subtle modeling fill, clean whites, no warm color cast. Portrait 3:4 composition, chest-up, camera at eye level, entire hairstyle and any head accessory inside frame with white margin, face mostly frontal, shoulders visible, no hands in frame. Single person only. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no border. References are inspiration ONLY: design a distinct new identity, significantly redesign facial proportions, eye shape, nose, jaw, hairstyle details, jewelry and costume while retaining the broad temperament and palette. Do not merely retouch or reproduce the source character. Character 21: Masculine composed fantasy swordsman aged 27. Dark black wavy swept-back hair with two shorter loose forehead strands, warm amber narrow eyes, strong cheekbones, broad squared chin, straight nose, medium warm skin. Ink-black overlapping robe with muted slate-blue textured lapels and simple silver collar clasp, no weapons in frame. Reserved noble charisma, refined CG. Input image 1 is the source mood reference ONLY: invent a clearly different person as described. Input image 2 is the RENDERING STYLE ANCHOR ONLY: match its 3D surface quality, refined facial sculpting, soft neutral white lighting and portrait crop. DO NOT copy the style anchor's identity, hair, clothes, jewelry or fantasy genre. Follow this character's specified genre and wardrobe. Retain a distinct original identity, no recycled same-face cast.
